analysis: No verified fills yet — the strategy has proposed trades but none filled inside displayed depth and limits (see its intents), or its trigger conditions have not met on the captured universe.

evidence.claim: Lottery demand for longshots is documented in prediction markets (demand for low-probability outcomes); treated here as a hypothesis, sized down, and tracked separately.

failure_mode: Most tickets settle at zero; exits are rare because one-sided books keep the bid at 0.00, so the 2x target usually never prints. Expect the worst equity curve in the race.
name: Penny Longshot Lottery
rule: On a universe market with traded volume, buy any side whose ask is between 0.01 and 0.05, sizing 10% of cash. Exit when the bid is >= 2x entry, else hold to the official settlement.
why: Deliberate max-return construction: pay pennies, and a win pays 100-200x. If the market over-prices longshots (the same bias SurePenny trades from the other side), the pennies are cheap; if the bias is absent, this is the strategy that bleeds — and the ledger will show exactly that.
